decisions.1: Supported by the two rejected CLI invocations in training; reusable across customers.
decisions.2: Supported by the accounting contract and successful training code; greatest revision must precede all filters.
decisions.3: Excluded: generic coding-error recovery advice is less directly useful than the selected reconciliation procedure.
decisions.4: Supported by the training contract and filter sequence; complements revision selection without copying customer answers.

scope: Fresh sessions and storage on the same six evaluation fixtures used in the previous experiment. No evaluation trace may generate guidelines or alter this selection.
primary: Exact currency totals, included event IDs, and matching saved report.json
secondary: Agent turns and rejected service calls, including failures and timeouts
comparison_limits: One paired trial per fixture, not a statistical reliability estimate or an isolated measurement of the adapter fixes. Both arms use the gateway bridge.
